title: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Ice Whiskers
description: Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls: Ice Whiskers — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Level 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Level 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

Well, hello there, Dungeon Runner. How have you been? Enough about you, I am doing good. Enough about me. My CATS are doing great! Eekee, ChinChin, Bubby, Willfun, Jyro, Liono, Skip-Skip, Frannie, Dalia, Battle Kit, Gunthar, Lambykinn, Voooom, Mrrrr, Xia, Pomp, Hekh, Jubles, Fran, Sinto, Zulu, Lumpy, Hackles, Sir Foof, West, Qwerty, Opo, Gremly, Taco, Bland, Mr. Doom, Vixen, Jibblet, Gibblet, Zibblet, Lord Hairy, Misses Moonbeam, Yip, Klomg, Dorry, Moopsies, Schmoopsies, Oopsies, Drama, Shama, Llama, Ding, Dong, Prince of Kitty Lane, Ephram, Qwalm, Professor Meow, Her Majesty Haggy, Winky, Herm, Dolla, Cantanker, Prime Minister Whiskers, Umlaut, and Zozo say hi. Of course, I have gotten more cats since I last talked to you, but they don't know who you are.

Now that we have the formalities out of the way, there is something I need to ask of you. Have you heard of Ratsputin's Nesting Dolls? No, not the kind of dolls that the Townston Commander likes to play with, these are actually monsters in Ratsputin's Gulag and they are quite a strange breed. They travel in a group, but you can't tell because you only see the biggest monster. The rest of the monsters are actually stored inside one another. I don't know how they do it, but I must now. If it is some sort of magic I can possibly use it in creating my Townston-famous potions!

Head out to Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing A which is off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 in Level 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Once you get there, seek out and slay the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls. Be prepared, this fight is unlike any you have faced before. Isn't that so dramatic of me to say! I love it. I think I will say it again when you get this repeatable quest. When you have finished your research by annihilation, return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, in Townston.

Turn-in:

Did you find this magical monstrosity? What have you learned? Tell me everything!

Objectives:

  • Slay Ice Whisker Blaster Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Seer Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Spitter Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Blademaster Nesting Doll
  • Slay Ice Whisker Broodling Nesting Doll

Level range: 85–100
